body.name: explicit certificate resolution schedule
body.construction: From \(\mathfrak E\), compute \(r_\delta\), \(\delta_{\mathrm{cert}}\), \(\eta_{\mathrm{cert}}\), \(R_{\mathrm{cert}}\), \(L_{\mathrm{cert}}\), \(\Delta t_{\mathrm{cert}}\), \(\Delta x_{\mathrm{cert}}\), \(\Delta q_{\mathrm{cert}}\), \(z_{\mathrm{cert}}\), \(\Delta z_{\mathrm{cert}}\), \(r_{\lambda,\mathrm{cert}}\), and \(p_{\mathrm{cert}}\) by their displayed formulas; use the viable lattice with time spacing \(\Delta t_{\mathrm{cert}}\), allocation-clock spacing \(\Delta q_{\mathrm{cert}}\), score box \([-R_{\mathrm{cert}},R_{\mathrm{cert}}]^K\), score spacing \(\Delta x_{\mathrm{cert}}\), a standardized Gaussian box \([-z_{\mathrm{cert}},z_{\mathrm{cert}}]^K\) partitioned into cells of width at most \(\Delta z_{\mathrm{cert}}\), and an \(\ell_1\) prior net of radius at most \(r_{\lambda,\mathrm{cert}}\).
